Tue 27th Jan:

Going to look at the North Australian Tropical Transect flux sites.

1. Howard Springs = AU-How
2. Adelaide Rivers = AU-Ade
3. Daly River Pasture = AU-DaP
4. Daly River Savanna = AU-DaS
5. Dry River = AU-Dry
6. Sturt Plains = AU-Stp
7. Alice Springs = AU-ASM

These flux sites are located along a precipitation gradient. This rainfall gradient is a 'natural laboratory'
